raw_text: BREAKING: Major exploit detected on WazirX Indian crypto exchange. Approximately $230M in digital assets drained from hot wallets. On-chain analysis shows funds moving through mixing services to addresses previously associated with Lazarus Group operations. This looks like a state-sponsored DPRK operation targeting Indian crypto infrastructure. Stolen assets include ETH, SHIB, and MATIC tokens.
